metadata.domain_framing: physics: 1-D harmonic oscillator in a constant external force field. Potential energy U(x) = (k/2) x^2 - F x where k is the spring constant (N/m) and F is the applied force (N). Equilibrium x_eq = F/k is where dU/dx = 0; minimum energy U_min = -F^2/(2k) is the work stored against the spring at equilibrium.
metadata.physical_interpretation: U_min = -F^2/(2k) is the work done by the external force as the mass settles to its new equilibrium; negative sign means the force does positive work on the mass.
